entities.name: Ramón Ramírez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ramón Emilio Ramírez is a Dominican former professional baseball pitcher. He pitched in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hiroshima Toyo Carp, and in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Colorado Rockies, Kansas City Royals, Boston Red Sox, San Francisco Giants, New York Mets, and Baltimore Orioles.
